data.reasoning: The package is a standard VCS AUR package for Rime input method configurations. data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement (inconclusive vs safe) was caused by an HTTP 400 API error in the qwen model during the PKGBUILD review, resulting in an inconclusive verdict. The deepseek model successfully reviewed the PKGBUILD and found it to be a standard, safe AUR build script.
coverage_issues: qwen model experienced an API error (HTTP 400) and failed to complete the PKGBUILD review.
learnings: Handle LLM API errors gracefully; a tool crash or API failure should not force an inconclusive package verdict if the error is clearly a transient tool failure.
